body: A star such as the Sun emits energy sustained for much of its life by fusion. The Solar System contains the Sun and the objects bound to it by gravity, including planets, smaller orbiting bodies and their moons. Earth follows an orbit around the Sun.

The Sun is one of the many stars in the Milky Way. A galaxy is a larger gravitational system with stars, gas, dust and other matter. Images of the Solar System and a distant galaxy show different scales and kinds of structure. The Solar System montage assembles separate pictures.

limitations: Astronomical maps and composites may combine different instruments or times. Read the provenance and scale before comparing apparent sizes on the page.
